## Test Case: AUTH-BVA-001

**Test Case ID:** AUTH-BVA-001
**Title:** Login with minimum valid email length (6 characters)
**Priority:** P2
**Module:** Authentication — Login — Email Field
**Scenario Type:** Boundary
**Risk Level:** Medium
**Tags:** @Boundary, @Auth, @P2, @EmailField, @MinBoundary

**Preconditions:**
- A user account exists with a 6-character email (e.g., a@b.cc)
- User is on the login page

**Test Steps:**
1. Navigate to the login page
2. Enter the minimum valid email: `a@b.cc` (6 characters)
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Login

**Expected Results:**
- Login succeeds with the minimum length email
- User is redirected to dashboard
- No validation errors shown
